content.text: Cristiano Ronaldo speaks via video link at the Tourise Riyadh event as he confirms the 2026 World Cup finals will “definitely” be his last major tournament. The 40-year-old Portugal international discussed his future after previously telling Piers Morgan Uncensored he would retire “soon”. Ronaldo joked that “soon” could mean “10 years” before admitting he expects his international career to end within “one or two years”. He said he still feels sharp, is scoring goals, and is enjoying every moment, but accepted that the 2026 World Cup is likely to be his final appearance on the biggest stage. Ronaldo reflected on his 25 years in the sport, his records across club and country, and said he remains proud of everything he has achieved.
